\label{lemma-iff-countably-indexed}
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X \to Y$ be a morphism of affine
formal algebraic spaces which is representable by algebraic spaces,
surjective, and flat. Then $X$ is countably indexed if and only
if $Y$ is countably indexed.

hold_reason: The original states TWO separate conditional implications: (1) if X\T→X is quasi-compact then the formal completion is locally adic*, and (2) if X is locally Noetherian then the completion is locally Noetherian. The proposed hypotheses record only the common S,X,T setup and the conclusions array strips BOTH local conditions. As structured theorem data this falsely advertises the two conclusions without their essential premises, despite the prose statement retaining them.
proposed_correction: Encode the separate cases, retaining each local premise with its own conclusion: [X\T→X quasi-compact]⇒[X_/T locally adic*]; [X locally Noetherian]⇒[X_/T locally Noetherian]. Preserve common S,X,T context; re-review.
